steps.title: Analyze Voice Input Failure
steps.description: Identify that missing package visibility <queries> tags in AndroidManifest.xml prevent SpeechRecognizer access on Android 11+.

steps.title: Optimize SpeechRecognizer Lifecycle
steps.description: Prevent heavy SpeechRecognizer recreation on continuous polling, which leads to Binder locks, ERROR_RECOGNIZER_BUSY, and freeze.

steps.title: Introduce Package Visibility Queries
steps.description: Add queries element in AndroidManifest.xml for RecognitionService and TTS_SERVICE.

steps.title: Correct BroadcastReceiver Security Flags
steps.description: Adjust Receiver registration in MainActivity to use RECEIVER_EXPORTED flag on Android 14+.

steps.title: Implement Robust Error Handling & Recoverability
steps.description: Handle busy states, timeout, and speech client errors cleanly by calling cancel/destroy only when needed.

steps.title: Sync Service Real-Time States with UI
steps.description: Connect MainActivity lifecycle with the background service's active status dynamically.

steps.title: Add Speech Intent Parameter Dynamic Binds
steps.description: Ensure the system locale matches the voice intent context inside the wake loop.

steps.title: Validate All Layout Resources
steps.description: Confirm activity_main.xml and XML background shapes align perfectly.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Source Compatibility
steps.description: Review code to confirm only Java 8 features (anonymous classes, no lambdas) are used.

steps.title: Building Popeen Voice Assistant
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to package the corrected voice assistant.
